_comment: The collection coverage ratchet. Each collection's mapped and live percentages (of its contract's operations in scope, from coverage/collections/<collection>) may not drop below these floors; internal/archtest's TestCoverageLedgers enforces it, fails a ledger with no floor and a floor with no ledger, and docs/reference/coverage shows the numbers. Raise a floor in the change that raises the percentage. Nothing compares a floor with its earlier value, so lowering one is caught in review of this file's diff: write the reason under _exceptions.
